questions.q: What is the author's name and what is the channel called?
questions.e: In the video: "ja sam Đorđe i dobrodošli na kanal Lične finansije" — I'm Đorđe, welcome to the "Personal Finance" channel.

questions.q: What does the author show in the picture at the beginning?
o: His portfolio's performance and the S&P 500 ETF
questions.e: In the video: "Zelenom bojom su označene performanse mog portfolija" — the green color shows my portfolio's performance.

questions.q: What is the author's first request to viewers?
o: To subscribe to the channel and hit the bell
questions.e: In the video: "da se pretplatite i da pritisnete zvonce" — subscribe and hit the bell.

questions.q: What does the author warn about regarding year-to-date performance?
o: It can change both up and down
questions.e: In the video: "One se mogu menjati i na gore i na dole" — they can change both up and down.

questions.q: What share of funds does the author recommend putting into the core?
questions.e: In the video: "U jezgro ćemo uložiti od 70 do 80% naših raspoloživih sredstava za investiranje" — we'll put 70 to 80% of our investable funds into the core.

questions.q: What, according to the author, should make up the core?
questions.e: In the video: "da ETF ili nekoliko ETF-ova čini tvoje jezgro" — so that one ETF or several ETFs make up your core.

questions.q: What are satellite positions for?
o: To bet on one's convictions and get a return higher than the core
questions.e: In the video: "mi želimo onako malo da se kladimo na to svoje ubeđenje" — we want to bet a little on that conviction of ours.

questions.q: What did the author do with one of his satellite positions?
questions.e: In the video: "odlučio da zatvorim jednu svoju satelitsku poziciju" — decided to close one of my satellite positions.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Dolazi do pada tržišta, a *portfolio* treba da bude otporan.
questions.e: Portfolio — an investment portfolio.

questions.q: Pokazao bih ti *prinos* u procentima.
questions.e: Prinos — return, yield, income.

questions.q: U portfolio mogu ući *obveznice* i zlato.
questions.e: Obveznica — a bond.

questions.q: Sklonost ka *riziku* je različita kod svakoga.
questions.e: Rizik — risk.

questions.q: To je *jezgro* mog portfolija.
questions.e: Jezgro — core; in the metaphor "jezgro i sateliti" (core and satellites).

questions.q: Svako ima drugačiji *investicioni* cilj.
questions.e: Investicioni — investment (adj.).

questions.q: Mogu da *nadmaše* performanse ETF-a.
questions.e: Nadmašiti — to surpass.

questions.q: Ne smemo da *zapustimo* jezgro.
questions.e: Zapustiti — to launch, to neglect.

questions.q: Pokazao bih ti rezultate na jednoj ___.
questions.e: Na + prepositional (locative) case: na jednoj slici — "in one picture".

questions.q: Prinos ETF-a prati ___ S&P 500.
questions.e: Pratiti + accusative case: prati indeks.

questions.q: Koristimo ETF koji u sebi sadrži akcije preko 3000 ___.
questions.e: Preko + number: genitive plural — kompanija.

questions.q: Većina nas radi neki drugi ___ tokom dana.
questions.e: Raditi + accusative case: neki drugi posao.

questions.q: Ulažemo novac u ___.
questions.e: U + accusative case (where to): u jezgro.

questions.q: Moramo obratiti pažnju na ___ između elemenata.
questions.e: Na + accusative case: obratiti pažnju na korelaciju.

questions.q: Investiraš u akcije ___ kao što su NVIDIA i AMD.
questions.e: Akcije + genitive plural: akcije kompanija — "shares of companies".

questions.q: Možeš da kupiš ETF koji sadrži samo ___ kompanije.
questions.e: Kompanije — plural, feminine: kineske kompanije.
